name: Democratic Party
description: Follow Democratic Party, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Activist David Hogg talks about the future of the Democratic Party
changes.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with gun violence prevention activist David Hogg about the future of the Democratic Party and calls for him to lead the Democratic National Committee.

changes.title: We’re about to find out how powerful progressives really are
changes.summary: Michigan is ground zero for the Democratic Party’s ideological war. Its marquee Senate race and two of its House primaries on Tuesday — in Michigan’s 7th and 13th Congressional Districts — will provide another crucial test of whether progressives can not only keep up their winning streak in safe-blue seats but also bre.

changes.title: Kansas Democrats Are Split on How to Keep the Governor’s Office
changes.summary: In a conservative state with a history of electing Democratic governors, the debate over which brand of Democrat can win sounds different.

changes.title: Author of Democrats’ 2024 Autopsy Says Party Left Out Key Chapter
changes.summary: A dispute over the chapter between the author and the Democratic National Committee has added to the party’s turmoil as it tries to look forward, not backward.

changes.title: Chicago’s Mayoral Race Is Taking Shape. But What About the Incumbent?
changes.summary: Several prominent Democrats already are running for mayor of Chicago. Mayor Brandon Johnson has not said whether he will seek a second term next year.

changes.title: Politics chat: Will Democrats use the war and high prices for their midterm strategy?
changes.summary: We look at how the Democratic party is approaching the midterms, and if they are using issues like the war in Iran and affordability, to their advantage.

changes.title: Trump Battles GOP Holdouts Amid Democrats’ Factional Fight
changes.summary: Meet the Press moderator Kristen Welker joins NBC’s Hallie Jackson on Sunday TODAY to discuss President Donald Trump’s conflict with fellow Republicans over Todd Blanche’s nomination as Democrats face an ideological battle in Tuesday’s Congressional Primary in Michigan.

changes.title: Democrats see a chance to flip a seat as focus on abuse claims mounts against Ohio Rep. Max Miller
changes.summary: Allegations against Rep. Max Miller have been public for years but have recently drawn increased media scrutiny amid an escalating legal back-and-forth with his former spouse, who is the daughter of Sen. Bernie Moreno.

changes.title: Week in Politics: Todd Blanche nomination; Michigan's Democratic Senate shakeup
changes.summary: Two nominations to watch: President Trump's of Todd Blanche to be U.S. Attorney General, and who Michigan Democrats will choose Tuesday to campaign for the U.S. Senate.

changes.title: Dems are increasingly desperate to get their Senate candidates to drop out in these races
changes.summary: Democrats vying for a pair of deep-red Senate seats are facing increasingly desperate calls from within their party to step aside for more promising independent candidates. But they say they won’t drop out — unless there’s divine intervention. Democrats Alani Bankhead of Montana and Julian Beaudion of South Dakota both.
